title: fix(security): append-only ledger for runtime role; lock shared demo logins
body:
Post-merge security gate after PR #3 (`main` @ `ebcfe72`). **Review before merging. Not merged by the agent.**

Two **High** findings, confirmed on real PostgreSQL 18 and over HTTP:

### H1: runtime role could rewrite or erase ledger and audit history
`0001_security_hardening.sql:17,20` granted `nile_app` UPDATE/DELETE on every table. As `nile_app` inside `withTenant`: `UPDATE audit_log`, `DELETE audit_log`, `UPDATE transaction_lines SET unit_price_minor = 1` and `DELETE stock_movements` all succeeded.
**Fix:** migration `0002_ledger_append_only.sql` revokes UPDATE/DELETE on `audit_log`, `sales_transactions`, `transaction_lines`, `stock_movements`, `cash_movements`. Runtime code only INSERTs into these tables; the only runtime UPDATE is the guarded stock decrement on `catalog_variants`, which is unchanged.

### H4: shared demo logins could be hijacked by one visitor
The demo password is public. Before this fix:
- `change-password` → the next visitor with `demo1234` got 401;
- `revoke-sessions` logged out every other visitor;
- `organization/leave` → every later visitor got 403;
- `update-user` allowed defacing the shared account.

**Fix:** a Better Auth `hooks.before` hook returns 403 `SHARED_DEMO_ACCOUNT_LOCKED` for these endpoints when the caller is a seeded demo account. Real tenant users are unaffected (tested).

### Evidence
- `npm run typecheck` passes; `npm test` 95/95 (91 + 4 new); `db:generate` reports no drift; `drizzle-kit check` OK.
- Mutation-checked in an isolated worktree. The new tests fail on unpatched `main` (3), without the `audit_log` REVOKE (2), with `/change-password` removed (1), and with the guard disabled (1).
- In-place upgrade on real PG as a non-superuser owner: migrations 2 → 3, a re-run is a no-op, existing sales/audit/movements are preserved.
- After the fix, ledger tampering is denied with 42501, and concurrency, idempotency and rollback gates still pass.

### Test change to note
`rls.test.ts` 3b now probes cross-tenant UPDATE/DELETE on `catalog_variants` instead of `sales_transactions`. Otherwise the new privilege error would hide the RLS filter the test is meant to prove.

### Not in this PR (open, Medium/Low)
- Payments are not recorded with the sale. This blocks the cashier UI under the engines-first rule.
- No CHECK constraints.
- Dev mode reflects any Origin; production settings depend on `NODE_ENV`.
- Better Auth skips the origin check when `NODE_ENV=test`, so the suite has no CSRF coverage.
- The `nile_app` assertion in `open.ts`.

Full report with file:line references is kept outside the repository.

title: First operational path: login → permissions → tenant → saved sale (+ DB/auth review fixes)
body:
# Review: engines ↔ database integration, auth, permissions, tenant isolation

- **Date:** 2026-10-14
- **Scope:** everything merged in PR #1 (engine cores) and PR #2 (DB layer),
  reviewed before building the first operational path (login → saved sale).
- **Method:** every suspected defect was reproduced with a failing probe on
  real PostgreSQL (PGlite) *before* it was fixed; every fix is pinned by a
  test that asserts the exact PostgreSQL error code; the end-to-end suite was
  mutation-checked (bugs planted on purpose must make tests fail).

## Findings

| # | Severity | Finding | Evidence | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | **Critical** | Cross-tenant FK hole: tenant A could insert a `transaction_lines` row pointing at tenant B's sale. PostgreSQL checks foreign keys **without** applying RLS. | Probe: insert succeeded as `nile_app` with tenant A context. | `UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)` on parents + **composite FKs** `(tenant_id, parent_id) → (tenant_id, id)` on every child (9 FKs). Test 3c asserts SQLSTATE `23503`. |
| F2 | High | Money columns were `integer` (int4): any amount ≥ 21,474,836.47 EGP overflowed. | Probe: `integer out of range` at 30M EGP. | All money columns `bigint`; app enforces `Number.isSafeInteger`. Test stores 30,000,000.00 EGP exactly. |
| F3 | High | Hand-written SQL migration contradicted ADR-0004 ("migrations generated by Drizzle Kit") and had already drifted from the Drizzle schemas (missing uniques in TS). | Diff of schema vs SQL. | Schemas are the single source; `drizzle-kit generate` produced `0000_nile_engines.sql`; RLS policies declared in TS (`pgPolicy`). The unapplied hand-written file was removed (never deployed anywhere). |
| F4 | High | Sale contract accepted `unitPriceMinor` from the client (customer-set prices). | `createSaleSchema` in PR #2. | Prices loaded from the catalog server-side; contracts are `.strict()` — unknown keys (price, total, tenantId) ⇒ 400. |
| F5 | High | Engines were not connected to persistence at all (no service layer); `withTenant` had never executed against a database. | Code inspection. | `recordSale`/`getSale`/`listCatalog` services; `withTenant` re-typed for Drizzle and covered by invariants 4 + 5. |
| F6 | Medium | RLS on the tenant registry (`organizations`) would have blocked Better Auth, which must resolve memberships **before** a tenant context exists. | Design review vs ADR-0005 §2. | Tenant = Better Auth `organization`. Identity/membership tables are platform-global (no RLS, accessed only by the auth module + server-side resolver); all 14 business tables are under RLS. |
| F7 | Medium | Runtime/migration role split (ADR-0005 §7) existed only inside a test. | Code inspection. | `0001_security_hardening.sql` creates `nile_app` (NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS), grants + default privileges, `FORCE RLS` on every RLS table; the app **refuses to start** if its effective role can bypass RLS. |
| F8 | Medium | Boolean flags stored as text `'true'/'false'`. | Schema. | Native `boolean`. |
| F9 | Low | Sale lines stored only an item id — receipts would change if a product were renamed. | Schema. | Name snapshots (`name_ar`, `name_en`) on each line. |
| F10 | Test gap | The first e2e suite did **not** catch "server trusts a client-sent tenant header" (mutation M3 survived). | Mutation run: 22/22 still green with the bug planted. | Added header/query tenant-spoofing test; M3 now fails the suite. |
| F11 | Ops | First boot crashed when the PGlite data folder did not exist (tests always used a fresh temp folder). | Live server start. | `openPglite` creates the folder. |

**Deferred (tracked, not blocking this path):** DB-level no-double-booking
(`EXCLUDE USING gist`) lands with the booking flow; Nx + pnpm workspace
(ADR-0001) still pending — the repo runs on npm for now; daily demo reset job;
delegated permissions (starting 0079).

## ADR-0005 §9 invariants — status

| Invariant | Test |
|---|---|
| 1. No tenant context → no rows | `rls.test.ts` #1 |
| 2. A cannot read B | `rls.test.ts` #2 + e2e §5 (404 on B's sale) |
| 3. A cannot insert/update as B | `rls.test.ts` #3a (42501), #3b, #3c (23503) |
| 4. Context is transaction-local | `rls.test.ts` #4 (after commit **and** rollback) |
| 5. Pooled connection never retains context | `rls.test.ts` #5 |
| Runtime role is not superuser/BYPASSRLS/owner | `rls.test.ts` runtime-role suite + boot assertion |
| Every tenant table has RLS + FORCE + policy | guard test (catches future tables) |

## Mutation check of the end-to-end suite

| Planted bug | Result |
|---|---|
| M1 remove `sale:create` permission check | caught (1 test fails) |
| M2 remove "stock ≥ qty" guard | caught (2 tests fail) |
| M3 trust a client `x-tenant-id` header | **initially missed** → test added → caught |


---
**Verification:** typecheck clean · 91/91 tests · drizzle-kit: no schema drift · live smoke run against the running server passed (login → sale → receipt).

title: Nile engines extraction + Factory baseline (docs/ADRs/prototype)
body:
## What this does
Extracts the five Nile engines (platform, transactions, booking, catalog, people) from Mohamed's production codebases into the Factory, on top of the existing arena baseline (ADR-0001..0006, agent skills, nilesys prototype) so `main` stops being empty.

## Engines
- **transactions**: kayyal (bug-free-garbanzo) decimal/cash/costing/line/regrade + 27 golden tests; Terranex integer-minor-units money = canonical storage; single decimal<->minor bridge
- **booking**: resources, slots, double-booking prevention, lifecycle machine (LenaBeauty + starting patterns, Africa/Cairo)
- **catalog**: variants/stock states, installments, Arabic validation, lead pipeline
- **people**: attendance/lateness/overtime, leave, loans, payslips
- **platform**: fail-closed tenant context (ADR-0002/0005), idempotency lifecycle, visitor branding, arabic/dates/phone utils

## Verification
- `npm run typecheck` — clean (strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess)
- `npm test` — **45/45 pass** (incl. 27 golden financial tests that may never change without an ADR)

Provenance for every file: `docs/REUSE.md`. Original source repos untouched. Screens come after engines, per the locked rule.
